_meta.note: Every third-party file vendored into the app must be listed here with an allowlisted (GPL-3.0-compatible, redistributable) license, its source, a pinned SHA-256, and a size budget. Enforced by scripts/check_vendor_manifest.py via tests/test_vendor_manifest.py — a file in a scan root that is not listed fails the gate. Update the hash deliberately when upgrading an asset.
